Instructions

You will hear short audio clips and your task in this study is to determine whether the clips are the same or different.

Response labels will be presented on the screen, and you use the 'z' key on the keyboard for one response, and the 'm' key for the other response. Shortly after you enter your response to a pair, the next one will play. There is a progress counter on the screen that will show you how many trials are remaining.

The experiment has three parts:

  1. A short practice session (a few trials) to familiarize you with the task.
  2. Block 1 of main trials.
  3. A short break, then Block 2 of main trials.

After completing both blocks, you will fill out a brief questionnaire.

Do not refresh the page at any point, as your progress will be lost.

Thank you very much for doing this, and for attending carefully to this task!

Practice: detect audio differences

This is a practice session with just a few trials to help you get familiar with the task. You will receive feedback on each response.

Please do your best to answer both quickly and accurately. You will receive feedback if your answers are too slow or too fast. To ensure quick responses, please rest your index fingers on the 'z' and 'm' keys so you can press them rapidly.
